en.lead: The capabilities on this page are in preview: their APIs are not stable, and an extension that declares one requires `vsql_allow_preview_extensions = ON` to install. See [Preview Capabilities]({overview}) for how to enable the preview tier and register a capability.

preview-capabilities.description: Preview capabilities give extensions access to server features that are still stabilizing. This page covers enabling the preview tier, the index of preview capabilities, and the registration pattern.

preview-auth.title: Authentication Methods
preview-auth.description: The vsql::preview::auth capability lets an extension provide a server authentication method: declare it, implement the handler, stage active roles, and auto-create accounts.

preview-keyring-services.title: Keyring Access and MySQL Services
preview-keyring-services.description: The vsql::preview::keyring capability reads and writes secrets in the MySQL keyring, and vsql::preview::mysql_services lets an extension consume MySQL registry services.

preview-server-variables.title: Status, System, and Session Variables
preview-server-variables.description: The vsql::status_var, vsql::sys_var, and vsql::session_var capabilities let an extension expose status counters and register global and per-session system variables.

preview-background-sql.title: Thread Worker and SQL Query
preview-background-sql.description: The vsql::preview::thread_worker capability runs a background thread driven by the server, and vsql::preview::sql_query executes SQL statements from a background thread.

preview-column-storage.title: Column Storage
preview-column-storage.description: The vsql::preview::column_store and vsql::preview::storage capabilities let an extension register a custom binary on-disk layout with InnoDB for one of its custom types.

preview-statement-events.title: Statement Events
preview-statement-events.description: The vsql::preview::statement_event capability runs an extension handler after each query finishes, with the query text, timing, row counts, and connection identity.
